description.value: Banchan Korean Bistro is a Korean restaurant in the Willoughby Town Centre mall in Langley, specializing in Korean, Korean Fried Chicken, and Asian cuisine. The restaurant operates primarily as a takeout destination with online ordering and real-time pickup notifications. It is a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Willoughby commercial corridor.
